_note: R76b. Every content/show-pages/*.json "summary" judged. verdict "drop" = no hero lede is rendered for that summary (a builder brief, or an unsourced claim); "keep" = it reads publicly and may be a lede or page meta. Rendering rule: lib/data/show-page-presentation.ts exports publicHeroLede(summary) (undefined for every "drop" summary, the summary itself otherwise); ShowContentState passes its result to NosHero. The decision is by summary TEXT, not page key, so a summary rewritten in Studio to real copy shows again. The "drop" list is reported to Lee-Ann in f18-spec.md. renderedAsHeroLedeToday records which summaries reached a hero lede on F17 main (ShowContentState routes: sa-exhibitors, international-guests, programme, wosa-conference, sponsors, symposium).
